title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.7.0 adds paired self-supervised wake-learning modules. Week 7.3 retains the strong gappy-POD baseline on masked low-rank wake reconstruction and corrects linear-probe pooling and sample-standard-deviation reporting. Week 7.4 generates sixteen compact Reynolds trajectories and measures target-label efficiency for instantaneous lift using frozen pretrained, random and POD-32 representations. Full trajectory splits, source-label selection costs, per-case errors, data hashes and coarse-CFD limitations are disclosed. The course includes 42 notebooks and 26 PDF lectures through Week 15. This is a MAPA-inspired educational experiment, not a reproduction of its neuroscience benchmark.
